definition: a person employed to carry luggage
description: A shopping trip through a covered market street. A hand passes a brown paper bag across while another hand lifts down a coloured mosaic lamp from a display of hanging lanterns. A smiling man in a bright patterned shirt takes the paper bag by its handles in front of stacks of painted plates and tea glasses. Then the camera follows a porter walking away down the narrow lane, carrying an enormous stack on his shoulders and head — rolled rugs, cushions, folded blankets, woven baskets and paper bags piled far above his head — with a silver teapot balanced on top.
